content.title: About
content.content: Spinach dip, yogurt based is a smooth sauce made from fresh spinach, natural yogurt, garlic, lemon juice and seasonings. It has a creamy texture, light tanginess and a vivid green color, making it perfect for snacks, vegetable sticks and Mediterranean dishes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The yogurt base makes the dip lighter and richer in probiotics compared with mayonnaise‑based versions.
Spinach provides more than 20 vitamins and minerals, including vitamin K, vitamin A and iron.
Greek yogurt, often used in the recipe, has higher protein and lower fat than regular yogurt.
The dip can be prepared at home in 10‑15 minutes using frozen spinach.
Flavor and color remain stable in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Yogurt and spinach together supply vitamin B12 and folate, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Probiotics in yogurt promote a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Carotenoids and lutein from spinach protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Low‑calorie protein source
items.content: Yogurt adds about 5 g of protein per 100 g of dip while keeping calories moderate.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Calcium from yogurt and vitamin K from spinach help strengthen bone tissue.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort from the yogurt.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Allergy to dairy can trigger reactions to the yogurt base.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: When salt is added, monitor total sodium, especially for individuals with hypertension.

items.title: Green leaf oxidation
items.content: Prolonged storage can cause loss of bright color and flavor of the spinach.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dip cold with vegetable sticks, crackers, or as a sauce for grilled meat and fish. It can also be spread on sandwiches, added to burritos, or used as a salad dressing.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the dip in an airtight container in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C. Shelf life is 5‑7 days. Before use, check for off‑smell or discoloration; discard if any sour or unpleasant odor appears.
